summary: FAIL on one material blocker. The report headline labels the net figure 35,741.52 as 'Gross revenue, EUR'. Gross revenue for the same population is 40,235.02, and the dashboard labels the same claim 'Net revenue (EUR)'. This breaks the spec's semantic trap (gross is not net) and the resolved revenue_recognition ruling (net_of_refunds) where the reader sees them. My own code (audit/results/final/evidence/redteam_recalc.py) recomputed every other release number from raw_data/orders.csv and all of them match: 201 raw rows, 174 in the population, 26 not delivered, 1 outside the period, net 35,741.
